title: Aftab Alam Khan v. State of U.P. and 3 Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
disposition: Disposed; theft-dues notice withdrawn; fresh order under Code.
headnote: Writ petition challenging a demand notice for recovery of electricity theft dues. The respondent electricity department stated that the notice had been withdrawn and that a fresh order would follow after hearing. Petition disposed of with liberty to pass that order strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Aftab Alam Khan approached the Allahabad High Court against a demand notice dated 17 September 2022 issued by respondent no. 4. The notice sought recovery of electricity dues in a case of alleged theft of electricity. At the hearing, counsel for the respondent electricity department told the Court that the impugned notice had been withdrawn. He further stated that a fresh order would be passed after the petitioner was given an opportunity of hearing.

holding_units.topic: Theft demand withdrawn; fresh order under Supply Code procedure
holding_units.holding: Where the electricity department withdraws the impugned demand notice for recovery of theft dues and undertakes to pass a fresh order after hearing the consumer, the writ is disposed of with liberty to the respondents to pass that order strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
holding_units.flag: The Supply Code, 2005 is named without any clause number.

principle_tags.application: The Court recorded withdrawal of the theft-dues demand and disposed of the writ without construing any clause, leaving a fresh order after hearing to the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner is liable for the alleged theft of electricity, and in what amount
not_decided.note: The impugned demand was withdrawn. Any fresh assessment after hearing was left to the respondents.
